description:
Canonical mail-client analog of JMAP-wzq9.32 (metadata-client).

`crate-jmap-mail-client/src/lib.rs:42`:

    pub trait JmapMailExt {
        /// Create a `SessionClient` bound to this client and session.
        ///
        /// All JMAP Mail method calls are made through the returned `SessionClient`.
        fn with_mail_session(&self, session: jmap_base_client::Session) -> methods::SessionClient;
    }

## The contract gap

`with_mail_session` accepts ANY `jmap_base_client::Session` — including one whose capabilities do not include `urn:ietf:params:jmap:mail`, or whose accounts list is empty, or whose primary-accounts map has no entry for the mail capability.

The validation is deferred to every individual method call via `SessionClient::session_parts()` (in `methods/mod.rs`), which returns `Err(ClientError::InvalidSession)` when the session lacks the relevant capability or primary account.

A caller reading the doc-comment on `with_mail_session` has no way to discover this. The function looks total (no `Result` return type), but every subsequent method call may fail with `InvalidSession` if the session was wrong.

## Why this matters

1. **Discoverability**: callers passing a session that does not advertise mail capability get `InvalidSession` errors on every method call, with no indication that the problem is upstream at `with_mail_session` rather than at the method itself.

2. **Defensive coding**: callers cannot write a guard like 'check whether the session supports mail before calling `with_mail_session`'. There is no public predicate.

3. **The asymmetry**: the trait promises 'JMAP Mail method calls are made through the returned SessionClient' but doesn't say what happens if the session can't support them.

## Fix paths

(a) **Doc-only**: add a paragraph to the trait doc-comment explaining that the returned `SessionClient` defers session-capability validation to per-method calls, and lists `InvalidSession` as the variant callers will see if the session is wrong.

(b) **Typed contract**: change return type to `Result<SessionClient, ClientError>` and pre-validate. Breaking change at 0.1.0. Forces callers to handle errors at session-binding time.

(c) **Predicate**: add a separate `JmapMailExt::session_supports_mail(&Session) -> bool` helper. Non-breaking. Callers can check before binding.

## Workspace propagation

Per workspace AGENTS.md "Canonical Templates", every extension-client sibling has the same `with_<ext>_session` shape and the same gap. Fix here first, then propagate to chat, calendars, tasks, contacts, filenode, sharing, metadata clients.

## Cross-refs

- JMAP-wzq9.32 — metadata-client side of this finding
- JMAP-wzq9.13 (closed) — earlier ratification of the SessionClient shape (does not preclude these doc-additions or wzq9.32 fix-path (a))
title: JmapMailExt::with_mail_session: deferred-validation contract not documented
